segments.name: Real estate finance
products: senior participation interests in first mortgage loans
segments.description: Directly originates and acquires commercial real estate-related credit assets, mainly first mortgage loans secured by institutional-quality properties in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business in a single operating and reportable segment, which is consistent with how the Company's Chief Executive Officer, who is its chief operating decision maker ("CODM"), assesses financial performance and allocates resources.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest, and prepayment penalties and exit fees, on the commercial mortgage loans the company originates or acquires.
revenueModel.evidence: Prepayment penalties from borrowers are recognized as interest income when received.
